blogs.title: Beyond FlashAttention-2: Why We Need a New Speed Demon for LLMs
blogs.description: An introductory post that explains the bottleneck of the attention mechanism in Large Language Models. It covers why previous optimizations (FlashAttention 1 & 2) reached a plateau on newer hardware like the H100 GPU and how FlashAttention-3 aims to break those limits to enable even longer context windows.

blogs.title: The Assembly Line of AI: How Asynchrony Fuels FlashAttention-3
blogs.description: A deep dive into the 'Producer-Consumer' model. This post explains how the researchers used warp-specialization and the Tensor Memory Accelerator (TMA) to create a hardware-aware assembly line, allowing the GPU to move data and perform calculations at the same time rather than waiting for one to finish before starting the other.

blogs.title: The Pingpong Strategy: Hiding Softmax Behind Massive Matrix Math
blogs.description: Focusing on the clever scheduling tricks in the paper, this post explains 'pingpong' scheduling. It describes how the team managed to overlap the computationally 'slow' softmax operations with the 'fast' matrix multiplications, ensuring that no part of the GPU's processing power goes to waste.

blogs.title: Going Low-Precision: How to Make AI Faster Without Losing its Mind
blogs.description: A technical look at the transition to FP8 precision. This post explains the challenges of low-precision math—specifically numerical errors and memory layout issues—and highlights the innovative 'block quantization' and 'incoherent processing' techniques used to keep the model accurate while doubling the speed.
